headline: Chinese Stocks Post Biggest Rally in Two Years on Support Signals
summary: Chinese stocks surged, with the CSI 300 rising 4.17%, after the State Council called for state-backed funds to play a greater role in stabilizing markets.
why: Direct state intervention and policy signals from Beijing heavily influence liquidity and sentiment in mainland Chinese equity markets.

impacts.name: CSI 300 Index
impacts.why: State Council calls for market stabilization drove a major rally across mainland equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Beijing signaled increased support and state-backed fund involvement to stabilize capital markets, triggering the largest rally in over two years.
